title: Raynaud-Gruson flattening of a finite type module on a space by a U-admissible blowup
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The flattening theorem for algebraic spaces: with B qcqs over a scheme S, X quasi-compact and locally of finite presentation over B, F a finite type quasi-coherent module on X whose restriction to the quasi-compact open U is of finite presentation and flat over U, there exists a U-admissible blowup B' -> B such that the strict transform F' is of finite presentation and flat over B'. The retained proof runs: etale-locally on X (strict transforms commute with etale localization, Divisors on Spaces) reduce to representable X -> B; etale-locally on B choose an affine W -> B, apply the schemes flattening theorem (More on Flatness, theorem-flatten-module) to get a finite type ideal on W whose blowup makes the strict transform flat and finitely presented; push the ideal down to B (lemma-push-ideal), form the corresponding blowup B' -> W' and control the double strict transform through the blowup-of-two-ideals and composition lemmas (Divisors on Spaces, blowing-up-two-ideals, strict-transform-composition-blowups, strict-transform-flat), concluding flatness and finite presentation of F' after descent along the etale cover. Retained author proof at lines 8796-8846.
